## Current result and next step

The [first-screen bindings](FIRST_SCREEN_BINDINGS.md) specify the synthetic
geometry, nine noise/quality cases, training, realization count, estimands,
proposed numerical loss limits and resource ceiling. They also specify how
the actual input bundles will be checked before the paired mapping comparison.
They are an execution proposal, not numerical evidence.

The metadata inventory found one usable starting candidate: 152389's legacy
single-pass, uninjected, all-chunk PTC output. Its signal and flags are present;
its actual cleaning uses network grouping and rank five. It has not been
admitted under the frozen PTC/MAP contracts, and an exact occurrence-coordinate
join still needs verification. Existing 123424 local products found in the
bounded search have diagnostics, but no full PTC signal file. No detector-noise
ranking or weighting outcome was calculated.

The requested discovery pair spans different source/date contexts. It is not
yet established to supply r0.2's representative/wider-noise contrast. Check
that contrast from the frozen training-only inventory before opening weighted
maps. If it is absent, report the restricted coverage and return the population
question; do not silently substitute observations. 129081 is reserved for new
weighting outcomes, but is already exposed historical development lineage and
cannot be called untouched qualification.

After collection, bind hashes, exact current input/coordinate/quality meanings
and the statistical evidence applicable to T2. Review the completed execution
